# everpure_azure_storage_pools (Data Source)

Lists Storage Pools in a resource group, or across the provider's whole `subscription_id` when `resource_group_name` is omitted.

To look up a single, already-known pool, use the [`everpure_azure_storage_pool` data source](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/data-sources/storage_pool) instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

# Lists every storage pool in one resource group.
data "everpure_azure_storage_pools" "example" {
  resource_group_name = "rg-storage-prod"
}

# Omit resource_group_name to list every storage pool in the subscription.
data "everpure_azure_storage_pools" "all" {}

# Storage pool IDs keyed by name, e.g. { "pool-prod-east" = "/subscriptions/..." }.
output "storage_pool_ids" {
  value = {
    for pool in data.everpure_azure_storage_pools.example.storage_pools :
    pool.name => pool.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `resource_group_name` (String) Resource group to list pools in. Omitted to list every pool in the provider's own `subscription_id`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `storage_pools` (Attributes List) The storage pools found, sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_pools))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the pools.


<a id="nestedatt--storage_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_pools`

Read-Only:

- `data_retention_period_in_seconds` (Number) How long a destroyed volume group, volume or snapshot is kept before being eradicated, in seconds.
- `id` (String) The full Azure Resource Manager ID of the storage pool.
- `internal_id` (String) Everpure's internal ID of the storage pool.
- `location` (String) Azure region the pool was created in, using its canonical short name, e.g. `eastus2`.
- `name` (String) Name of the storage pool.
- `platform_console` (Attributes List) Platform console access (GUI, REST API and CLI) from the injected subnet. Null when console access is disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_pools--platform_console))
- `provisioned_bandwidth_in_mbps` (Number) Bandwidth provisioned for the pool, in megabytes per second (MB/s).
- `provisioned_iops` (Number) Total I/O operations per second (IOPS) provisioned for the pool.
- `reservation_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the Reservation that funds this pool.
- `resource_group_name` (String) Name of the resource group the pool lives in.
- `tags` (Map of String) A mapping of tags assigned to the pool.
- `vnet_injection` (Attributes List) The virtual network and subnet the pool is injected into. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_pools--vnet_injection))
- `zone` (String) Availability zone within the region, e.g. `"1"`. Empty or null for a region with no availability zones.

<a id="nestedatt--storage_pools--platform_console"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_pools.platform_console`

Read-Only:

- `api_enabled` (Boolean) Whether REST API access is enabled.
- `cli_enabled` (Boolean) Whether CLI (SSH) access is enabled.
- `default_username` (String) Default username for console access, system-populated.
- `gui_enabled` (Boolean) Whether GUI access is enabled.
- `subnet` (Attributes List) Per-subnet console access details, system-populated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_pools--platform_console--subnet))
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) Subnets enabled for console access.

<a id="nestedatt--storage_pools--platform_console--subnet"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_pools.platform_console.subnet`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the subnet.
- `management_ip_address` (String) Management IP address assigned to the subnet.
- `service_backend_ip_addresses` (List of String) Service backend IP addresses assigned to the subnet.



<a id="nestedatt--storage_pools--vnet_injection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_pools.vnet_injection`

Read-Only:

- `subnet_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the delegated subnet the pool's network interfaces are placed in.
- `virtual_network_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the virtual network `subnet_id` belongs to.
